post.meaning: Lust, anger and greed are the three gates to ruin. Give up all three.
post.caption:
श्रीकृष्ण का संदेश, भगवद्गीता से 🦚

📖 Bhagavad Gita, 16.21

अगर यह बात सच लगी, तो अपनों के साथ Share करें। 🙏

#krishna #bhagavadgita #radhekrishna #gita #sanatandharma

reel.meaning: Ever worshipped with heavenly flowers by the teacher of the gods, higher than the highest, the supreme Self: to that Sadashiva I bow.
reel.caption:
हर हर महादेव 🔱 भोलेनाथ की शरण में एक पंक्ति

📖 Adi Shankaracharya (attributed), Lingashtakam, verse 8

उस एक इंसान को भेजें जिसे आज यह सुनना चाहिए। 💛

#mahadev #harharmahadev #shiva #bholenath #mahakal
